name: Grade 7 IT Practice: April Week 8 - Sensor Conditions
description: Practice words for ultrasonic sensors and if/else reactions.

words.definition: Using sound waves to measure distance.
words.example: The ultrasonic sensor checked how close the wall was.

words.definition: A value measured by a sensor.
words.example: The reading changed when the robot moved closer.

words.definition: A limit where an action changes.
words.example: The threshold told the robot when to stop.

words.definition: A rule that can be true or false.
words.example: The condition checked if the distance was less than 10 centimeters.

words.definition: A code word used to check a condition.
words.example: The if block stopped the robot near the wall.

words.definition: A code word for what happens when an if condition is false.
words.example: The else block kept the robot moving when the path was clear.

words.definition: Able to respond when something changes.
words.example: The reactive robot changed behavior when the sensor reading changed.
